confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and draft-beer anchors use current Dubai city averages. Alcohol prices vary by licensed venue; cocktail and wine estimates use the high local beer baseline and broad mid-tier bar ranges. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with substantial seasonal and location uncertainty; no live booking listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink are based on Dubai city prices, while accommodation is a broad destination-market estimate.
